column5:
At first, the candle is unlit (no flame showing).
When a person clicks/taps the candle, the candle lights up with a flame animation.
As the candle lights, the black-and-white photo slowly gains colour.
After some time, the photo fades back to black and white again.

To stop fake engagement:

Each person can only light the candle once.
Or, even if they click many times, only their first lighting is counted.

Another idea is to make the photo permanently gain more colour as more people light candles overall:

0–100 candles lit → photo is almost fully black and white (about 95% monochrome)
500 candles → a little colour appears
2,000 candles → photo becomes half colour / half monochrome
5,000–10,000 candles → photo becomes fully colourful and vibrant

So the experience becomes:

A user lights a candle.
They see a personal animated moment where the portrait comes alive in colour.
At the same time, every new candle contributes to gradually restoring the portrait permanently for everyone.
